title: Association of grey matter cerebral blood flow with white matter integrity in relation to youth bipolar disorder.
authors: Grigorian A, Zou Y, Kennedy KG, Dimick MK, MacIntosh BJ, Goldstein BI.
figures: Relationship between cerebral blood flow (CBF) in the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) and fractional anisotropy (FA) in the cingulum, covariate-adjusted for age and sex, among youth with bipolar disorder. This plot demonstrates a significant positive relationship, whereby higher ACC CBF predicted higher cingulum FA in BD.

Relationship between cerebral blood flow (CBF) in the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) and fractional anisotropy (FA) in the cingulum, covariate-adjusted for age and sex, among asymptomatic female youth with bipolar disorder. The plot demonstrates a significant positive relationship, whereby higher ACC CBF predicted higher cingulum FA.
